entities.summary: The Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome , also sometimes called the Yumenoshima Tropical Plant Dome, is a botanical garden located at 3-2, Yumenoshima, Kōtō, Tokyo, Japan. It is operated by the Tokyo Metropolitan Park Association and is open daily except on Mondays; an admission fee is charged.
